prompts.prompt:
Create ONE final production logo icon for MURAL Presenter, not a concept board. Use the supplied mural image as the visual-family reference: refined American hand-painted street mural, warm cream, deep navy ink outlines, teal, cobalt blue, restrained golden yellow. The product is a multi-agent system whose agents share responsibility for authoring an editable presentation.
Design a highly legible bold uppercase M monogram from three interlocking painted planar strokes, suggesting collaborating slide panels forming one wall. Preserve a clear M silhouette at 32px. Predominantly teal, one cobalt side-plane and one small golden yellow accent, confident dark navy outlines, warm ivory internal accent. A pair of tiny friendly cyan eye shapes can be subtly integrated into a small central navy negative-space inset, connecting to the reference robots, without turning the whole icon into a robot illustration.
Art direction: professionally reduced logo, hand-inked contours with controlled brush character, mostly flat opaque paint, just a hint of screenprint grain inside large shapes. Balanced near-square silhouette, generous transparent padding on all sides, full mark visible. NO floor, no wall background, no drop shadow, no gradients, no 3D plastic, no chrome, no additional wordmark, no mini icons, no sheet of alternatives. Exact single asset, square high resolution, genuinely transparent background. Keep the reference palette and handcrafted warmth but reduce the busy scene to an ownable emblem.

Create ONE final standalone transparent mascot asset for MURAL Presenter. Use image 1 as the canonical hand-painted robot character and American street-mural style reference; image 2 is the new brand's M icon and controls the exact teal/cobalt/golden yellow/cream/navy palette and paint treatment.
Draw a single friendly small mural-making robot, entire body, three-quarter view facing slightly right, centered with generous clear padding. Same robot family as image 1: rounded ivory shell, thick fluid dark navy ink contours, glossy DARK NAVY face with two cheerful cyan arched eyes, two small antennae ending in round ivory tips with tiny yellow collars, cream mitten hands and broad feet. Wear a cobalt blue artist's apron with a small simple teal M patch. One hand proudly holds an upright small wooden-handled paint roller with teal paint; the other supports two neatly overlapped presentation cards, the front has only a minimal cobalt bar chart. Give the figure a lively confident balanced pose and refined expressive draftsmanship.
Style is flat hand-drawn editorial mural illustration, opaque gouache color, subtle controlled dry-brush and screenprint grain. Exactly consistent with the original provided robot mural. Suitable for research project identity and stickers, sophisticated charming rather than babyish. Restrained details readable when scaled down. No wall, floor, scenery, ladder, paint cans, cast shadow, text, wordmark, watermark, extra robots, glossy 3D rendering or photorealism. Genuine transparent background. Square high-resolution single-asset composition.

Create ONE exquisite final production GitHub README brand banner for "MURAL Presenter", a multi-agent presentation authoring research system. Wide horizontal composition approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2400x800 or 3072x1024, NOT a contact sheet.
Reference image 1 is the user's current publicity mural and defines the visual world. Reference image 2 is our new M monogram; preserve its silhouette and palette when incorporated. Reference image 3 is our new canonical robot mascot; all robots in this banner must be recognizably the same illustrated family.
Art direction: an art-directed American street mural on fine warm ivory painted plaster, clean confident hand-painted navy linework, rich opaque teal and cobalt blue brushwork, restrained golden yellow accent sweeps, authentic subtle wall grain. More refined and spatially composed than the busy reference. Absolutely no glossy 3D, gradients, generic tech glow or stiff UI cards.
Composition: a large immaculate custom hand-painted block-letter wordmark "MURAL" owns the LEFT/CENTER 55 percent with warm breathing room. Exact spelling M U R A L, bold readable navy/teal lettering, clever hand-painted edges, the M derived from the supplied monogram but no face over remaining letters. Put small well-spaced uppercase "PRESENTER" directly underneath. These are the ONLY words in the image. Keep wordmark horizontal, unobstructed, wonderfully legible at README width.
On the RIGHT 40 percent, a team of three robots collaboratively create ONE continuous two-page presentation wall. One blue-apron robot on a slim wooden ladder paints a teal border with a roller; one golden-apron robot on the ground aligns the second page; one teal-apron researcher holds a small book and points to the same shared work. The presentation panels contain only a refined blue chart and a teal illustrated landscape, with no fake words. Beautifully drawn small paint tools and subtle brush-stroke ground connect them; two or three broad paint swashes link the artwork across the width without passing over the lettering. The scene illustrates differentiated responsibility and shared authoring.
Use asymmetrical editorial hierarchy and a deliberate rhythm of quiet cream space and lively painted areas. No vegetation wall, no giant background M competing with the wordmark, no tiny text, no acronym table, no fake badges, no frames around the complete banner, no watermark. Keep all key elements well clear of outer edges. It must feel like a polished cultural design studio's signature mural for an open research project.

Edit this supplied completed MURAL Presenter banner to create its matching DARK THEME production variant. Preserve EXACTLY the wide approximately 3:1 composition, the M monogram, all five letters MURAL, the correctly spelled word PRESENTER, all three friendly robots, the two presentation panels, ladder and brush arrangement, proportions, positions and all recognizable shapes. This is a tightly controlled palette and material change, not a new layout.
Replace the ivory plaster wall background with beautifully matte deep navy ink-painted plaster (#102b3e approximate), retaining subtle authentic hand-painted wall texture with restraint. Keep robots ivory with dark navy outlines and bright cyan faces. Keep the left M monogram blue/teal/gold and its warm cream contour, visibly separated from the dark wall. Change the U R A L letter fills to alternating warm ivory and soft bright teal with controlled brush texture so they read instantly against navy. Make PRESENTER warm ivory. Existing cobalt and golden-yellow sweeps remain readable but avoid electric neon; lighten teal selectively. Keep the chart and landscape panels ivory and teal. No new shadows, 3D, glowing effects, text, badges, icons, extra characters or scene changes. Keep the handcrafted American street-mural identity and refined paint finish. Export one complete horizontal banner with an opaque dark background, no border.

Create one final social sharing / paper publicity image for MURAL Presenter. Landscape 1.91:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2400x1256 or 2048x1072. Reference 1 is the approved new brand's light mural banner; reference 2 is the approved standalone robot; reference 3 is the canonical M logo. Match those EXACT brand-family shapes, not a different robot or monogram.
Design a polished hand-painted American street mural poster on warm cream fine plaster. Teal, cobalt, dark navy, golden yellow, authentic opaque paint, confident ink contours, balanced paper-like open space.
Layout: on the left 58%, prominent navy/teal "MURAL" wordmark (M uses supplied monogram) with smaller letterspaced "PRESENTER". Below, place the FULL current research title in carefully drawn exceptionally legible dark navy modest-size lettering, exactly these words with natural line breaks:
"Multi-Agent Units of Responsibility"
"for Authoring Long-Horizon"
"Presentations"
On the right 38%, three small friendly cream-shell cyan-eyed robots jointly paint and align two large presentation pages on one wall: blue-apron roller painter on a wooden ladder, golden-apron page assembler, teal researcher holding a book. The pages show a clean cobalt bar chart and teal landscape, no text. Keep the shared page installation compact and refined, avoid a crowded pile. Add very restrained teal/blue/yellow broad dry-brush flourishes near top-right and bottom, leave the title area quiet and flat cream for comfortable reading. All elements safely inside the frame.
Only the brand name and the exact research title should be written. No conference names, no author names, dates, badges, performance scores, URLs, invented slogans, watermark, fake tiny text or mockup border. Not glossy, not 3D, no tech gradients. One finished cohesive publicity graphic, no contact sheet.

Create a final transparent horizontal MURAL Presenter logo lockup, one asset only. Reference 1 is the approved mural banner and its exact custom wordmark; reference 2 is the approved M symbol. Extract and carefully redraw only this lettering system on a genuine transparent background, preserving its identity.
The text must be EXACTLY "MURAL" on one line, with smaller widely letterspaced "PRESENTER" immediately beneath. The M is the supplied canonical interlocking three-panel M icon with tiny cyan smiling eyes: teal upper chevron, cobalt left panel, golden yellow right panel, warm ivory borders and navy contours. The remaining letters U R A L have confident refined broad hand-painted block forms, alternate cobalt and teal, with subtle dry-brush paint texture matching the reference. Dark navy restrained edges ensure readability; warm ivory hairline separation where needed. All letters aligned to a coherent baseline, balanced spacing. "PRESENTER" dark navy uppercase clean hand-lettered sans serif, excellent spelling and generous tracking.
Wide approximately 3:1 composition with even transparent safety margins. No robots, wall, paint splashes beyond the letter shapes, paper texture in the background, poster, scenery, shadows, badge, extra words or variants. Preserve warm handcrafted American mural character while making the logo more reduced and cleaner than the banner. This must be usable atop a plain light interface or paper. True alpha transparency, not a fake checkerboard.

Edit the supplied transparent MURAL PRESENTER wordmark into a matching transparent DARK-BACKGROUND wordmark. Keep the exact pixel composition, placement, proportions, letter shapes, margins, M icon, paint texture and spelling. Keep the background fully transparent, with the same aspect ratio approximately 3:1.
Only adjust the pigment palette for visibility on dark navy backgrounds: leave the M icon's teal, cobalt and gold planes, cyan eyes and ivory borders intact; make its outer contour ivory where needed for separation. Change U and A from cobalt to warm ivory; change R and L to bright soft teal. Change the entire smaller PRESENTER line to warm ivory. Preserve navy inset details and tasteful hand-painted edges. No background added, no scene, no extra text, no shadow, no glow, no border or layout changes. This is the paired inverse logo of the same identity, not a redesign.

Produce ONE final square GitHub/avatar image for MURAL Presenter using the supplied approved M monogram. Preserve the exact recognizable M silhouette, color placement and tiny friendly cyan eye shapes. This is a presentation variant of that existing logo, not a new logo.
Center the M on a warm ivory lightly grained matte background. Mark fills approximately 65 percent of canvas width and height, leaving generous uncluttered safe margins so a circular profile crop will not cut the mark. Retain navy outline, teal upper stroke, cobalt left panel and golden yellow right panel. Simplify scattered brush flecks near the outline and small internal scratches so the icon reads cleanly at 32 and 64 pixels, while maintaining the hand-painted mural identity. More controlled opaque colors and decisive edges than the large master. No wording, no extra mascot, no decorative surrounding swooshes, no border ring, no badge, no scenery, no mockup, no drop shadow, no gradient or glossy 3D. Opaque background, professional balanced app/avatar composition, square high-resolution.

Create one polished MURAL Presenter brand identity overview board showcasing the supplied approved assets as a coherent American street-mural identity. This board is an OVERVIEW only; do not invent alternative logos. Reference 1 is the canonical M icon. Reference 2 is the canonical mascot. References 3 and 4 are the approved light/dark mural banners. Reference 5 is the approved paper social card.
The identity metaphor is multiple responsible collaborators painting one shared presentation. Preserve recognizable M silhouette, tiny cyan eye motif, hand-drawn cream-shell robots with navy outlines, teal/cobalt/yellow paint, ivory plaster and dark navy variants.
Landscape high resolution 2400x1600 approximately, an editorial 2-column by 3-row grid with generous cream gutters, fine dark navy separators, deliberate hierarchy, sparse accurate typography. Top row: a large wordmark presentation on clean ivory, and a dark navy banner application. Middle row: large M monogram with a small circular-avatar application alongside it, and the painter robot mascot isolated on ivory. Bottom row: the paper publicity image application, and a restrained material/palette panel with five large painted swatches labelled only "IVORY", "NAVY", "TEAL", "COBALT", "GOLD".
A tasteful small header says "MURAL PRESENTER" and "STREET MURAL IDENTITY". Panel labels can be only "WORDMARK", "DARK", "MARK", "MASCOT", "CAMPAIGN", "PALETTE". No other dense explanatory text, no fake interfaces, no charts unrelated to the reference, no merchandise mockups, no futuristic glow, no extra invented slogans, no photoreal 3D or watermark. Keep the approved asset shapes consistent between panels. An elegant cultural branding presentation with joyful craft and disciplined spacing, not a chaotic moodboard.

Make one strictly localized correction to this MURAL Presenter brand overview board. Remove ONLY the tiny invented slogan "PAINT BETTER TOGETHER" and its underline in the extreme upper-right header corner. Fill that small area with the surrounding warm ivory paper/plaster background, keeping the teal/cobalt/yellow brush decoration immediately to its left intact. Do not replace the slogan with any words. Preserve the rest of this entire 2-column, 3-row board: same layout, borders, MURAL PRESENTER header, STREET MURAL IDENTITY heading, logos, typography, robot, campaign picture, five palette swatches and labels. No other edits or additions. Output the complete same-aspect-ratio board.
